assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 4 (N847A6_ch2_main_20240326011501_20240326013001)
assets.author: Private residential security camera, Dundalk MD; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: Night, wide security-camera view west across the Patapsco River from Dundalk (cropped and enlarged, soft). The lit containership Dali sits mid-frame on the horizon; about 12 s in (camera clock 01:25:00) its deck and accommodation lights go out and the hull becomes a dark silhouette. Bright light cluster at left near the bridge; harbor lights at right.

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 4 (N847A6_ch2)
assets.author: Private residential security camera, Dundalk MD; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: Same night view from Dundalk (camera clock about 01:25:48-01:26:10). The Dali is a dark silhouette on the horizon; about 10-12 s in its lights come back on, matching the 0125:58 power restoration. Soft, enlarged security-camera image.

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 4 (N847A6_ch2)
assets.author: Private residential security camera, Dundalk MD; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: Same night view from Dundalk (camera clock about 01:26:40-01:27:14). The lit Dali has moved left toward the bridge lights at frame left; its lights dim/fade as the second blackout hits (0127:04). Soft, grainy, enlarged security-camera image; ship is small in frame.

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 3 (Dock East_Key Bridge-2024-03-26)
assets.author: Industrial facility CCTV, west bank of the Patapsco; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: Night, monochrome security camera on the west bank looking at the lit Key Bridge across the horizon; the Dali's lights are a cluster under the central span. Hazy lens with out-of-focus blobs. Bridge still intact throughout (camera clock not corrected).

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 3 (Dock East_Key Bridge-2024-03-26)
assets.author: Industrial facility CCTV, west bank of the Patapsco; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: The collapse, seen from the west bank at night in monochrome: the lit bridge spans the horizon; about 13-16 s in, the deck lights over the channel and to the right drop out as the central truss falls; by about 22 s only the approach-span lights and the ship's lights remain, with a dark gap where the main span was. Distant, hazy, no detail of people or vehicles.

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 1 (1 Bridge March 23 2024 1339-1354)
assets.author: Industrial facility CCTV, west bank of the Patapsco; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: Overcast daytime, March 23, 2024: wide fisheye view across the Patapsco to the intact Francis Scott Key Bridge; the loaded containership Dali, inbound, passes under the central truss span. Grey water in the foreground.

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, CCTV Attachment 1 (1 Bridge March 23 2024 1339-1354)
assets.author: Industrial facility CCTV, west bank of the Patapsco; released by NTSB
assets.license: NTSB public docket release (CCTV recorded by a private camera owner; not itself a US Government work - rights flagged)
assets.description: Closer crop of the same daytime view: the intact Key Bridge truss with the Dali, stacked with containers, sliding under the main span between Piers 17 and 18 on its arrival three days before the accident. Slightly soft (enlarged).

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, VDR Group Attachment 7, ECDIS playback video
assets.author: NTSB (Vessel Recorders group)
assets.description: Handheld video of the Dali's ECDIS chart display in playback mode (pink/blue/green electronic chart, ship outline on the dredged channel heading southeast). Readout shows 26 Mar 2024, LMT about 01:20-01:24, heading about 141 degrees, speed about 8 knots. The ship symbol advances down the channel toward the bridge. Screen at a slight angle, dark surround.

assets.title: NTSB docket DCA24MM031, VDR Group Attachment 6, Portable Pilot Unit playback video
assets.author: NTSB (Vessel Recorders group)
assets.description: Screen recording of the pilot's portable pilot unit (dark nautical chart app). The green ship outline sits in the Fort McHenry Channel just short of the bridge line (brown band across the channel), with distance labels to the piers (790 ft, 199 ft); top bar shows SOG about 6.5 kn, heading 159 degrees, time 2024-03-26 01:28. The ship slides to starboard toward the bridge. Narrow (640 px) - best on a board or inset.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 4 (p.29): The Dali's helm and conning area
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Photo of the Dali's navigation bridge looking forward: central helm console with steering wheel, bow-thruster and main-engine controls, flanked by radar/ECDIS screens; dark windows; wooden stair rail at left. Overhead lights on (they would be off at night underway).

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 16 (p.48): Plant at 0129:09, Pier 17 impact
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB power diagram 'Time: 0129:09 Pier 17 Impact': DG2 running through the TR2 path, LV and emergency boards lit, main engine still dark. The final frame of the blackout sequence.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 19 (p.57): Dali's starboard bow striking Pier 17
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB illustration of the Dali's bulbous bow and starboard bow striking the two-column Pier 17 (impact area shaded black), water line and mudline marked; inset photo of the bow with bridge truss lying across the fo'c'sle and containers.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 21 (p.59): Damage to Spans 16-18 and Pier 17
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Aerial photo looking toward the Dali's port side: the bridge truss (Span 17, Span 18 deck) draped over the Dali's bow and containers; Pier 17 column, Spans 16-17 and the remaining approach spans labelled.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 38 (p.75): Collapsed western span of the Sunshine Skyway Bridge (1980)
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Black-and-white historical photo: the freighter Summit Venture beside the collapsed span of the Sunshine Skyway Bridge, Tampa Bay, 1980; broken deck edge in foreground, bare pier frames and hanging truss behind.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 40 (p.77): Collapsed Interstate 40 bridge (2002)
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Photo of the collapsed Interstate 40 bridge over the Arkansas River, Webbers Falls, Oklahoma: deck sections sloping into the river, dolphins (round sheet-pile cells) protecting piers, guardrail in foreground.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 51 (p.115): Terminal Block 381 and Wire 1
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Left: close-up of a vertical stack of numbered grey terminal blocks (364-404) with wires; Terminal Block 381 boxed in yellow, arrow to 'Wire 1'. Right: an HHI field engineer's gloved fingers holding the tiny Wire 1 ferrule (circled in yellow) beside the switchboard. The hero image of the cause.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 53 (p.118): Wire 1 and Wire 3 in Terminal Block 381
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Close-up of numbered wire labels and terminal blocks 376-384; Terminal Block 381 outlined in red, Wire 3 and Wire 1 labelled.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 56 (p.121): Exemplar terminal block and X-ray of Terminal Block 381
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Exemplar terminal block assembled and disassembled on blue background (connection points, spring clamps, conductor bar, polymer form labelled); right, X-ray images of Terminal Block 381 connection points 1 and 3.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 62 (p.127): Electrical arcing damage
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Microscope montage: the spring-clamp gate face from Connection Point 1 with an inset showing two pits labelled 'Arcing damage'; lower images show the spring clamp in an exemplar block and the Wire 1 ferrule edge with circled erosion spots.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 64 (p.146): How arcing could occur in the gap
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB 3D illustration: a wire ferrule hovering just above the spring-clamp gate face with yellow sparks ('Electrical arcing') and 'Arcing damage' marks; below, a cutaway photo of Terminal Block 381 showing where the ferrule sat (blue). 'Illustration not to scale'.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure E-1 (p.230): Dali with collapsed bridge across its deck, March 28, 2024
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Aerial daylight photo: the bent steel truss of the Key Bridge lying across the Dali's crushed bow and stacked containers, a damaged container in the water in front, small boats nearby.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 5 (p.31): Configuration of Dali plant at departure
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB diagram (dark background, yellow = energized): ship profile above, one-line power diagram below with DG3 and DG4 running, HV switchboard, transformers TR1/TR2, LV switchboard, emergency switchboard, main engine and bow thruster. Labelled 'Time: Pre-accident'; legend of abbreviations (DG, HR, LR, TR, HVR, LVR, EBT) at bottom.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 8 (p.36): Plant at 0125:00, initial blackout
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB power diagram 'Time: 0125:00 Initial underway blackout': DG3, DG4 and main engine still lit yellow on the HV side, but the HV-to-LV path (HR1/TR1/LR1) is dark; low-voltage and emergency switchboards de-energized. Part of the animated blackout sequence.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 11 (p.40): Plant at 0125:58, LV power restored
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB power diagram 'Time: 0125:58 LV power restored': power flows again from DG3/DG4 through HR1/TR1/LR1 to the LV switchboard (yellow path); main engine still dark.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 13 (p.43): Plant at 0127:04, second blackout
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB power diagram 'Time: 0127:04 Second underway blackout': DG3 and DG4 dark (tripped), DG2 shown starting; HV and LV switchboards dark; only the emergency generator and emergency switchboard lit.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 17 (p.50): Main spans with maintenance vehicle positions
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB line drawing: elevation of the continuous through-truss spans (Spans 16-23, Piers 15-23, pier fendering systems) above, plan view below with the Dali angled into Pier 17 in the Fort McHenry Channel, Dolphins 1 and 2 marked. Numbered circles 1-7 show the work-crew vehicles (passenger vehicle and inspector, stake bed trucks, pickups with light towers, concrete mixer, generator truck) clustered over Spans 18 and 20.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 36 (p.73): Blue Nagoya vs Dali size comparison
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: NTSB graphic: top, bridge elevation (185 ft clearance) with the small 1980 Blue Nagoya and the much larger Dali side by side; bottom, plan view of the 700-ft channel with the 390-ft Blue Nagoya next to the 984-ft Dali (beam about 65 ft vs 158 ft).

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 42 (p.81): The Dali's HV and LV switchboards
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Two photos side by side: the long cream-coloured high-voltage switchboard line-up (a crew member in orange coveralls at the far end) and the low-voltage switchboard, in the engine control room. Labels 'High-voltage switchboard' / 'Low-voltage switchboard', NTSB watermark.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 58 (p.123): Microscope image of the Wire 1 ferrule
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Digital microscope close-up of the crimped silver Wire 1 ferrule with copper showing through; arrows mark gouges from initial installation and from post-accident examination; 0.025 in scale bar.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Figure 61 (p.126): End views of the Wire 1 and Wire 3 ferrules
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Microscope end views of the stranded copper wires inside each ferrule: Wire 1 shows a depression in one corner and erosion (arcing) and smeared material; Wire 3 is round and intact.

assets.title: MIR-25-40 Table 5 (p.135): AF summary for the Key Bridge
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Report MIR-25-40
assets.description: Table: annual frequency of collapse by pier (16-19), inbound/outbound/total; Piers 17 and 18 about 0.0014 each; total AF 0.002921 (vs AASHTO threshold 0.0001 for critical bridges).

assets.title: M/V DALI Refloat and Transit (May 20, 2024)
assets.author: Christopher Rosario, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: The Dali arriving at a marine terminal under container cranes: close view of the crushed, torn starboard bow and twisted steel on the fo'c'sle, fireboat and tugs alongside.

assets.title: M/V DALI Refloat and Transit (May 20, 2024)
assets.author: Christopher Rosario, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: The wreck site after the ship left: remaining stubs of the bridge, twisted truss sections in the water, crane barges working to clear the channel, grey sky.

assets.title: Precision Cutting Animation - Francis Scott Key Bridge Response (May 8, 2024), VIRIN 240508-A-ZO053-1001
assets.author: Dakota Pope, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Grey 3D animation: the fallen truss section resting on the ship's bow; small charges flash at cut points along the truss, the steel splits into pieces that drop into the water beside the ship.

assets.title: NTSB Preliminary Report DCA24MM031, Figure 7: the Dali's route between the first blackout and the bridge
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Preliminary Report DCA24MM031
assets.description: NTSB graphic on dark blue: the Dali's track curving down to the bridge (grey diagonal line) with numbered points 1-7 and a legend at left: 1 breaker trips, blackout; 2 main engine shuts down; 3 power restored; 4 tug call and anchor ordered; 5 second blackout; 6 VHF warning; 7 the Dali hits the Key Bridge. Orange ship shape at the bridge; Dolphins 1 and 2 marked. Substitute for MIR Fig 9 (which uses a Google Earth background).

assets.title: NTSB Preliminary Report DCA24MM031, Figure 8: NTSB investigator at the Dali's HV switchboard
assets.author: NTSB, Marine Investigation Preliminary Report DCA24MM031
assets.description: Portrait photo: an NTSB investigator (back to camera, grey 'NTSB' T-shirt, white hard hat with ear defenders) examining the cream HV switchboard panels and applying tamper-evident seals; gauges and control panels above.

assets.title: Key Bridge Response 2024 (March 26, 2024), DVIDS video 919034
assets.author: Petty Officer 3rd Class Carmen Caver, U.S. Coast Guard (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Sunrise, March 26, 2024: the Dali alongside the collapsed truss, a coxswain in silhouette, the twisted truss rising from the water, a broken bridge stub against an orange sky, Coast Guard helicopter overhead.

assets.title: Key Bridge Response 2024 (March 26, 2024), DVIDS video 919034
assets.author: Petty Officer 3rd Class Carmen Caver, U.S. Coast Guard (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Morning, March 26, 2024: Coast Guard and fire boats on scene; view between two concrete piers to the wreck on the Dali; crew inside a response boat; close shot of the Dali's bow (name 'DALI' visible) with the white truss crushed over it.

assets.title: Vessels transit newly reopened Baltimore Federal Channel (June 12, 2024), VIRIN 240613-A-QH057-1003
assets.author: Bobby Petty, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Time-lapse, June 12, 2024: tugs and then a large grey ship pass through the reopened Fort McHenry Channel between the bare stubs of the old bridge piers; crane barges and a clamshell bucket in the foreground.

assets.title: Key Bridge Unified Command removes portion of bridge on top of M/V Dali with precision charges (May 13, 2024), VIRIN 240513-G-KT616-1002
assets.author: Petty Officer 2nd Class Ronald Hodges, U.S. Coast Guard (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Clear day, May 13, 2024, side-on view of the whole Dali: the truss section over the bow is blown apart by cutting charges, a grey smoke cloud rises and drifts over the containers, truss pieces drop into the water.

assets.title: Timelapse: Key Bridge Response Unified Command Moves M/V DALI (May 20, 2024), VIRIN 240520-A-ND890-1101
assets.author: David Gray, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Time-lapse from a pier, May 20, 2024: the Dali is pulled away from the wreck site and slides out of frame, leaving the bridge wreckage behind; overcast sky. (Second camera angle after 8 s excluded.)

assets.title: NTSB press release Nov 18, 2025: correct wire-label banding installation (illustration)
assets.author: NTSB
assets.description: NTSB illustration on white (landscape, high-res version of MIR Fig 65 top panel): a wire with white label banding sitting above the blue collar; ferrule fully inserted into the spring-clamp gate of a grey terminal block; red-circled close-up. Caption 'Correct wire-label banding installation'.

assets.title: NTSB press release Nov 18, 2025: wire-label banding installation on Wire 1 (illustration)
assets.author: NTSB
assets.description: NTSB illustration on white (companion to banding-correct-installation): the label banding slid down over most of the collar, making it too fat to enter, so the ferrule is not fully inserted in the spring-clamp gate; red-circled close-up 'Wire not fully inserted into spring-clamp gate'. Caption 'Wire-label banding installation on Wire 1'.

assets.title: Unified Command performs controlled demolition, precision cutting (May 13, 2024), VIRIN 240513-A-ZT698-7081
assets.author: Christopher Rosario, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Close telephoto, May 13, 2024: the collapsed bridge truss lying across the Dali's bow erupts as the precision-cutting charges fire; black smoke and spray burst from the steel and the truss sags. Starts on the blast (source's burned-in countdown excluded).

assets.title: B-roll Container removal from M/V Dali (April 7, 2024), VIRIN 240407-G-DV874-3002
assets.author: Petty Officer 3rd Class Mikaela McGee, U.S. Coast Guard (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Drone shot looking down, April 7, 2024: the Dali's crushed bow with stacked and crumpled containers, the bridge truss draped across the fo'c'sle, brown river water.

assets.title: M/V DALI Refloat and Transit (May 20, 2024)
assets.author: Christopher Rosario, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Baltimore District (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Overcast morning, May 20, 2024: the refloated Dali, still fully stacked with containers and with a crumpled bow, moves slowly up the river escorted by tugs and small boats.

assets.title: Key Bridge Response 2024 (March 26, 2024), DVIDS video 919034
assets.author: Petty Officer 3rd Class Carmen Caver, U.S. Coast Guard (via DVIDS)
assets.description: Pre-dawn, March 26, 2024, from a Coast Guard boat: the fallen truss in silhouette against a deep blue sky beside the Dali's lit containers, then the Dali's lit stern with the broken bridge beyond against the sunrise, lights reflecting on the water.

assets.title: NTSB B-Roll - Aerial Imagery of Francis Scott Key Bridge and Cargo Ship Dali (March 2024)
assets.author: NTSB (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: NTSB drone, overcast day: flying low along the surviving approach roadway that ends abruptly over the water; ahead, the bare Pier 17/18 stubs, broken truss and the Dali stranded beyond. Wreckage of a span visible in the water as the drone passes the cut end.

assets.title: NTSB B-Roll - Aerial Imagery of Francis Scott Key Bridge and Cargo Ship Dali (March 2024)
assets.author: NTSB (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: NTSB drone: high view down the line of the old bridge, a broken pier column and fallen truss sections lying in the grey-green water, the Dali with its container stacks in the background; drone descends toward the twisted steel at the pier.

assets.title: NTSB B-Roll - Aerial Imagery of Francis Scott Key Bridge and Cargo Ship Dali (March 2024)
assets.author: NTSB (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: NTSB drone orbit: the collapsed white truss draped across the Dali's bow and lying in the river, ship fully loaded with colourful containers, calm water.

assets.title: NTSB B-Roll - Aerial Imagery of Francis Scott Key Bridge and Cargo Ship Dali (March 2024)
assets.author: NTSB (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: NTSB drone low over the water behind the Dali's stern: the ship stands where the main span was, the remaining approach spans and piers of the bridge stretch away on either side, a fallen truss in the water; overcast sky.

assets.title: Aerial view of the Dali bridge allision (March 2024)
assets.author: U.S. Coast Guard Petty Officer 3rd Class Kimberly Reaves (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: Wide aerial in low warm light: the Patapsco River with the bridge's main spans gone; truss wreckage in the water mid-frame, the Dali with a truss section over its bow, the cut-off approach spans and piers on both sides, power plant with stacks on the far shore, small boats on scene. 1280 px wide.

assets.title: New Navy 3D sonar images reveal striking details of Baltimore's Francis Scott Key Bridge wreckage site (240409-N-QH057-1101)
assets.author: U.S. Navy NAVSEA Supervisor of Salvage and Diving (SUPSALV) (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: False-colour 3D sonar scan of the riverbed (rainbow colours on black): collapsed truss members sticking up from the bottom, the massive main bridge pier support in the centre, the federal channel slope at left; labels along the bottom 'FEDERAL CHANNEL', 'Limited Access Channel', 'Main Bridge Support', 'Collapsed Truss'. 1447 px wide.

assets.title: Map of the MV Dali bridge collision
assets.author: Michael.C.Wright (via Wikimedia Commons)
assets.description: Clean grey-and-blue street map of Baltimore harbor and the Patapsco River: labelled 'Baltimore' (downtown), 'Seagirt Marine Terminal, Port of Baltimore', and 'Collision location' at the mouth of the harbor; scale bar 0-2 mi.
